Project Overview:

This is a report of our group’s study of Darboux Transformations and its role in the spectral analysis of one-dimensional Schrödinger operators.

  • Developed the Hilbert space formalism for spectral analysis.
  • Applied the method to three Schrödinger operator eigenvalue problems:
    • The simple harmonic oscillator.
    • The reflectionless potential.
    • The Coulomb potential.
  • Explored broad implications in quantum mechanics and mathematical physics.
